description: This file implements a CredentialService class for managing credentials, including storing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing credentials using in-memory storage with thread safety. It also interacts with external modules for encryption/decryption and utilizes imported models for credential data structures.

classes.name: CredentialService
classes.description: A service class managing credentials with thread-safe in-memory storage, supporting operations like store, retrieve, update, delete, and list.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the CredentialService with an empty credential dictionary and a threading lock.

methods.name: str _get_key(self, service_type: ServiceType, base_url: str)
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for storing credentials based on service type and base URL.

methods.name: StoredCredentials store_credentials(self, request: CredentialsRequest)
methods.description: Encrypts and stores credentials received in a CredentialsRequest object.

methods.name: Optional[StoredCredentials] get_credentials(self, service_type: ServiceType, base_url: str)
methods.description: Retrieves stored credentials for a given service type and base URL.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,str]] get_decrypted_credentials(self, service_type: ServiceType, base_url: str)
methods.description: Returns credentials with the password decrypted, for active credentials only.

methods.name: bool update_last_tested(self, service_type: ServiceType, base_url: str)
methods.description: Updates the last tested timestamp for stored credentials.

methods.name: bool delete_credentials(self, service_type: ServiceType, base_url: str)
methods.description: Removes stored credentials for specified service type and base URL.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] list_stored_services(self)
methods.description: Lists all active stored service credentials with their details.
